_doc: Shared vocabulary and case format for the Week 2 test set (eval/testsets/week2_cases.jsonl), the review page (tools/review) and the future W2.1 classifier output. Source of rules: docs/priority_policy.md (v0.3 draft) and docs/priority_policy_decisions.md. Change it here only.
rules: expected.issues is non-empty if and only if 'field_complaint' is the primary intent or one of secondary_intents.
Each issue is one distinct fault; a message reporting two faults has two issues (decision 7).

issue.urgency is null if and only if issue.urgency_status == 'needs_clarification' (the incident itself is ambiguous, decision 5). Missing location alone never nulls urgency; it goes to missing_fields.
Intent 'emergency' without a field_complaint has no issues and no urgency; the answer directs to 112 first (decision 4).
referral_needed is 'yes' or 'unknown' when another body (e.g. the electricity distributor) may own the fault; the municipality still records it (decision 8). The model never names the external body.
scope, onset_text and sensitive_use are extracted facts for the Week 4 queue ordering; never invent them (decision 9). Use 'unknown' / null when not stated.
For type 'unanswerable' cases answerable is false.

case_format.source_id: W1-xx when carried over from week1_inputs.jsonl, else null
case_format.ingredients: list of ingredient numbers 1-8 from the brief

issues.urgency: one of urgencies, or null only when urgency_status is needs_clarification
issues.location: {"neighborhood": str|null, "street": str|null, "detail": str|null} or null when nothing is stated
issues.onset_text: verbatim duration/onset phrase from the text (e.g. '2 haftadır', 'since Monday') or null
issues.sensitive_use: short phrase for an explicitly connected sensitive use (e.g. 'school route') or null

expected.ticket_id: YV-YYYY-NNNNNN string or null (never 'correct' a malformed id)
expected.missing_fields: list of missing_field_values the assistant should ask for, [] when none

case_format.expected_behavior: one or two English sentences describing the correct final answer/behaviour
case_format.answerable: false when the honest answer is 'I can't answer / not in scope / not in the documents'
